shadows.name: mobile-navigation
shadows.purpose: Separates the open mobile navigation rail from the workspace.

shadows.name: modal-dialog
shadows.purpose: Lifts dialog surfaces above the workspace.

motion.name: control-color
motion.purpose: Quiet hover and state transitions on buttons.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The stylesheet disables nonessential transitions and animations when requested.

breakpoints.name: wide-content
breakpoints.purpose: Adds horizontal breathing room to wide layouts.

breakpoints.name: compact-rail
breakpoints.purpose: Narrows the desktop rail and workspace gutters.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Stacks dashboard, assistant and settings content.

breakpoints.name: mobile-menu
breakpoints.purpose: Replaces the fixed rail with a labeled menu.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled blue action with readable semibold text and a clear focus ring.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 18px; gap: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: 600 1rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.16s, color 0.16s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { translate: 0 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet outlined action on a clean surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 600 1rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.16s, color 0.16s; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--soft); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Readable field with quiet border and clear keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 1rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Rail item with muted default, soft hover and pale active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar); } .ds-nav button { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--rail-muted); text-align: left; font: 500 1rem/1.35 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: var(--rail-hover); } .ds-nav button.is-active { background: var(--rail-active); color: var(--rail-active-ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verification Chip
components.description: Compact status label; review state uses amber and still includes status words.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 6px; margin-left: 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--soft); color: var(--accent); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-review { background: var(--gold); color: var(--gold-ink); }

components.name: Course Card
components.description: Clean bordered surface with generous padding; no resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 1.5rem/1.3 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.9375rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Gobbler gives coursework a calm, practical place to be read and acted on. A deep navy rail anchors a warm paper workspace; clear headings, generous body text and visible source evidence keep attention on the next useful action. Its academic character comes from disciplined typography and quiet surfaces, not decorative school imagery.

The same reading discipline carries through Today, tasks, calendar, courses, sources, assistant and settings. The existing Gobbler mark remains the identity anchor. The interface supports light, dark and system themes, localized controls, keyboard use and reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper work surfaces framed by a deep navy navigation rail.
Readable, spacious working text with serif page titles.
Source and review states stay explicit and readable.

rules.name: The Readable-First Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary copy at 17px, controls at 16px and supporting copy at 14px or larger.

rules.name: The Next-Action Rule
rules.body: Keep the next assignment and its date/source easy to find before secondary setup or aggregate information.

dos: Do keep source provenance and review state visible beside the coursework they qualify.
Do use the supplied light/dark semantic tokens so status contrast survives each theme.
Do retain generous line-height and wrapping for long course names, questions and dates.
donts: Don't reduce supporting text below 14px or controls below 16px.
Don't communicate verification or errors through color alone.
Don't replace the reading desk with decorative mockups or promotional artwork.
